content.text: The zone air temperatures show Core_mid rose ~2°F in H2 2018 while other zones held flat. But the store only exposes Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor and two setpoint streams for the whole building — no zone power, no occupancy, no VAV supply/discharge temp or airflow, no CO2. Without a redundant temperature reference (or a load/flow signal), a +2°F shift at a single zone is indistinguishable from a sensor offset drifting.
